snippets.name: YTD Sales
snippets.description: Year-to-Date sales with optional fiscal year support.
snippets.dax:
YTD Sales =
VAR _Result =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        DATESYTD(DimDate[Date], "6/30")
    )
RETURN
    _Result

snippets.name: Sales vs Previous Year
snippets.description: Compare current sales to same period last year.
snippets.dax:
Sales vs PY =
VAR _Current = [Total Sales]
VAR _PY =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DimDate[Date])
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(_Current - _PY, _PY, 0)

snippets.name: Running Total
snippets.description: Cumulative running total over a date axis.
snippets.dax:
Running Total =
VAR _MaxDate = MAX(DimDate[Date])
VAR _Result =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        DimDate[Date] <= _MaxDate,
        ALL(DimDate[Date])
    )
RETURN
    _Result

snippets.name: Pct of Grand Total
snippets.description: Percentage contribution to the grand total.
snippets.dax:
% of Grand Total =
VAR _Current = [Total Sales]
VAR _GrandTotal =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        ALL(DimProduct)
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(_Current, _GrandTotal, 0)

snippets.name: Moving Average 3M
snippets.dax:
Moving Avg 3M =
VAR _Period = 3
VAR _Result =
    AVERAGEX(
        DATESINPERIOD(
            DimDate[Date],
            MAX(DimDate[Date]),
            -_Period,
            MONTH
        ),
        [Total Sales]
    )
RETURN
    _Result

snippets.name: Cumulative Total
snippets.description: Cumulative total within the current filter context.
snippets.dax:
Cumulative Total =
VAR _CurrentDate = MAX(DimDate[Date])
VAR _Result =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        FILTER(
            ALL(DimDate),
            DimDate[Date] <= _CurrentDate
        )
    )
RETURN
    _Result

snippets.name: Rank by Sales
snippets.description: Rank products or categories by total sales.
snippets.dax:
Rank by Sales =
VAR _CurrentSales = [Total Sales]
VAR _Result =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            ALL(DimProduct[ProductName]),
            [Total Sales] > _CurrentSales
        )
    ) + 1
RETURN
    _Result

snippets.name: Distinct Customer Count
snippets.description: Count of unique customers with transactions.

snippets.name: Safe DIVIDE Wrapper
snippets.description: Template for safe division — never use raw /.
snippets.dax:
Safe Ratio =
VAR _Numerator = [Measure A]
VAR _Denominator = [Measure B]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(_Numerator, _Denominator, 0)

snippets.name: Dynamic Top N
snippets.description: Show top N items controlled by a slicer parameter.
snippets.dax:
Is Top N =
VAR _N = SELECTEDVALUE(TopNParameter[Value], 10)
VAR _Rank = [Rank by Sales]
RETURN
    IF(_Rank <= _N, 1, 0)
